mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO `task_checkin` (task_id, seq, target_lng, target_lat, lng, lat, accuracy_m, deviation_m, observed_at, reported_at, reporter_id, reporter_name, remark) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{seq}, #{targetLng}, #{targetLat}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{accuracyM}, #{deviationM}, #{observedAt}, #{reportedAt}, #{reporterId}, #{reporterName}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, seq, target_lng, target_lat, lng, lat, accuracy_m, deviation_m, observed_at, reported_at, reporter_id, reporter_name, remark, create_time FROM `task_checkin` WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY seq, observed_at, id
